remarks: Welcome to your dream rental in the highly sought-after Westport, CT! This beautifully updated 4/5 bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home sits proudly at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, ensuring privacy and tranquility in a family-friendly neighborhood. Situated in the esteemed Coleytown School District, this residence combines modern elegance with classic charm. The spacious interior features a bright, open floor plan perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Enjoy the updated kitchen with high-end appliances, stylish cabinetry, and ample counter space. The inviting living areas include a cozy family room, a formal dining space, the versatile private room downstairs with full bath and closet could be an office or playroom or be used as a guest room for company. Outside, the private backyard and two decks presents a perfect setting for outdoor gatherings or peaceful moments of relaxation. The location is ideal for families, with proximity to top-rated schools, parks, and shopping. This updated gem in Westport is ready for you. Don't miss out on the opportunity to live in this exceptional property in a prime location.
